description: Which devices a sender wraps a message key for, given the recipient as the server resolved it and what the sender remembers (docs/40 §12.3). Shared by the TS senders (core decideWrapTargets) and, from stage 3, the Rust gateway. Lists are signed with Ed25519 seeds of all-0x01 (root) and all-0x02 (other). Since stage 5 (docs/40 §15.2) an agent without a list is not sent to (no_list). Seed all-0x05 is a second signer (docs/40 §17): a case's history, when set, is what GET /recipients/device-lists returns, the versions after the one asked for (null: it cannot be fetched).

cases.name: listed: wrap for every listed device the server returns
the server adds a device: not wrapped for
the server swaps a key: the listed key is used
the server removes a device: it is dropped
asked by a DID the list no longer names: still that agent
asked by a DID seen under another agent before
asked by a listed DID
asked for another agent

no listed device is still active

a signer the pin trusts: no history needed
a signer the pin does not trust yet: followed from the pin
